sourcePrompt: Jefe Ramírez — recurring agency chief. Dark formal suit, white shirt, burgundy tie, silver agency badge on lapel. Short black hair with grey temples. Illustrated graphic novel / noir watercolor style.

El Coleccionista — master villain. Gold monocle, white leather gloves, eagle-head cane, charcoal suit. White hair, pale skin. One side slightly shadowed. Illustrated graphic novel / noir watercolor style.
El Tejedor — Unit 5 boss lieutenant. Dark unkempt hair, dark circles, rumpled dark linen jacket. Tense exhausted expression, still intelligent. Illustrated graphic novel / noir watercolor style.

El Genio (Ricardo Montoya Díaz) — boss fight accomplice. Very voluminous dark curly hair, medium brown skin, dark t-shirt. Confident self-assured expression. Illustrated graphic novel / noir watercolor style.

El Camaleón — Unit 1 criminal. REGENERATED as an image-to-image edit of the original portrait, changing ONLY the hat: the ornate sombrero de charro was replaced with a plain elegant black wide-brimmed hat. Face, mustache, pose, clothing, background and noir watercolour style preserved from the source so he still matches the other three suspects in the lineup. The charro hat was removed deliberately — see content/characters/unit-01.json notes.
La Serpiente — Unit 1 suspect. Elegant young woman, long straight black hair, NO hat, Ciudad de México. Calm calculating expression. Noir watercolor style.
El Toro — Unit 1 suspect. Short stocky powerful man, NO mustache, NO hat, Monterrey México. Quiet calm expression. Noir watercolor style.
El Pájaro — Unit 1 suspect. Young 22yo man, tall slim, NO mustache, NO hat, Cancún. Friendly relaxed bilingual expression. Noir watercolor style.
Don Rodrigo — Unit 1 witness. Elderly 65yo man, white hair, white mustache, plaid shirt, kind serious expression. Guadalajara market vendor. Noir watercolor style.
El Tecladista — Unit 2 criminal. Tall 17yo teen boy, school uniform, very serious expression unusual for his age.
La Estudiosa — Unit 2 distractor. Tall teenage girl, school uniform, warm friendly studious expression.
El Gracioso — Unit 2 distractor. Short stocky teen, BLONDE hair (unique in lineup), big goofy grin, school uniform.
El Tranquilo — Unit 2 distractor. Tall shy teen boy, school uniform, headphones visible around neck, introverted posture.
Sra. Torres — Unit 2 teacher witness. Professional woman, dark-rimmed glasses, dark blazer, authority figure.
La Sombra — Unit 3 criminal. All-black clothing, black cap pulled low, pale skin. Elusive evasive. Spain.
Carlos el Metroista — Unit 3 witness. Madrid metro worker uniform + reflective vest. Friendly tired face.
El Heredero — Unit 4 criminal. Nervous guilty 19yo Costa Rican teen.
Tia Elena — Unit 4 distractor. 45yo Costa Rican woman, market bags visible, worried maternal.
El Fantasma Digital — Unit 5 criminal. Dark hoodie, large black backpack, nighttime hacker aesthetic.
El Cocinero Secreto — Unit 6 criminal. White chef jacket + apron, nervous guilty young 22yo Colombian.
El Técnico Oscuro — Unit 7 criminal. ALL-BLACK festival crew uniform (not blue), large black bag.
El Coleccionista local — Unit 8 criminal. 55yo Peruvian man, formal dark business suit incongruously in Andean market.
Don Aurelio — Unit 8 witness. 70yo elder Andean market vendor, traditional poncho.
Rosa Mamani — Unit 8 distractor. 48yo Andean woman, traditional braids + pollera dress + straw hat.
María (testigo) — Unit 8 audio witness. 42yo Andean market vendor, calm trustworthy.
El Primo Activo — Unit 4 distractor. Coffee farm worker, tired physical labor expression.
La Hija Seria — Unit 4 distractor. 48yo professional businesswoman, dark blazer.
Tía Elena interrogation — Unit 4 witness. Worried protective maternal expression.
La Ingeniera — Unit 5 distractor. Blue folder + tablet visible.
El Consultor — Unit 5 distractor. SILVER/GREY hair key difference.
La Programadora — Unit 5 distractor. BLUE backpack + headphones around neck.
Tomás García — Unit 5 witness. Building security guard uniform.
El Jefe de Cocina — Unit 6 distractor. Tall white toque blanche, head chef.
La Sous Chef — Unit 6 distractor. Chef uniform, wooden spoon, focused on stew.
La Repostera — Unit 6 distractor/witness. Pastry chef, flour on apron, spotted the criminal.
La Cantante Famosa — Unit 7 distractor. Stage performer, microphone visible.
El Guitarrista — Unit 7 distractor. BLUE festival uniform (not black), guitar.
La Periodista — Unit 7 distractor. TV journalist, professional camera, press badge.
El Turista — Unit 8 distractor. Foreign tourist, camera around neck, backpacker.
Carmen Quispe — Unit 8 distractor. 21yo university student, backpack + market bag.
